description: This Java class 'ConnectivityHeaders' provides utility methods for checking if debug logging is enabled for headers and payloads based on message headers. It defines specific header value checks to control logging behavior in connectivity monitoring.

classes.name: ConnectivityHeaders
classes.description: Final utility class for handling connectivity-related message headers, specifically for debug log controls.

methods.name: isHeadersDebugLogEnabled
methods.description: Checks if headers are allowed for debug logging based on header values.

methods.name: isPayloadDebugLogEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the payload is allowed for debug logging based on header values.

methods.name: getDebugLogValue
methods.description: Retrieves the debug log value from headers, returning 'ALL' if not present.
